items.title: Third US strike on Iran triggers strait closure, attacks on regional bases
items.description: Iran reportedly responded to Sunday morning's US attacks by closing the Strait of Hormuz and targeting US bases in Qatar, Kuwait and Jordan.

items.title: Body of missing Queensland mum found in bushland
items.description: A 48-year-old man has been charged with murder after the body of missing mother Jana Armstrong was found in bushland late on Saturday.

items.title: What falling home prices mean for affordability
items.description: Australian house prices have recorded their biggest monthly fall since 2022. For young buyers hoping it's a turning point, economists have some bad news.

items.title: China ballistic missile test pushes case for Pacific security pact
items.description: Pacific Minister Pat Conroy says the testing of a nuclear-capable missile damaged China's reputation and has strengthened the case for a Pacific security pact.

items.title: Why Norway feels 'bitter' after contest of controversy against England
items.description: Norway felt England's equaliser shouldn't have stood after the ball appeared to get a deflection off a wire holding up the "spider-cam" above the pitch, directly leading to England gaining possession and scoring.

items.title: Bellingham goes big time again, as England continues down hard road
items.description: Jude Bellingham has been scrutinised and criticised in the months leading up to the World Cup. Now he stands as England's best player so far, carrying the Three Lions' title dreams on his shoulders.

items.title: Live: 'World's Biggest Birthday Party' for Arrow, Bunker denies Knights twice
items.description: The NRL is holding the "World's Biggest Birthday Party" for Jai Arrow as the South Sydney Rabbitohs host the Newcastle Knights in Sydney. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Bulldogs, Eagles heading for thrilling finale as Dees face Tigers
items.description: Western Bulldogs and West Coast kick off a Sunday triple-header as round 18 of the AFL comes to a close. Follow live.

items.title: As Japan's population shrinks, 'urban bears' are moving in
items.description: When Araki Osamu first heard reports a bear had been seen in the streets of his home town, a 1-hour bullet train ride north of Tokyo, he dismissed it as "fake news".

items.title: Australian man dies in Bali while awaiting deportation
items.description: An Australian man has died in a Bali immigration detention centre while awaiting deportation.

items.title: Man charged after filming inside Dezi Freeman's hideout
items.description: A man who entered the property where Dezi Freeman had been hiding out in north-east Victoria has been charged with trespass.

items.title: Owner taken to court over $1m damage bill to 110yo cafe
items.description: The heritage-listed former Paragon Cafe in Katoomba was once considered a success story of Greek entrepreneurship, but has now landed in the NSW Land and Envicronment Court.

items.title: UK police arrest 28-year-old man in Ann Widdecombe murder case
items.description: Police previously arrested, then later released, a 26-year-old man in relation to the alleged murder, after Ann Widdecombe's body was found in her residence on Thursday.

items.title: In this friendship group there are 'no Jews, no Muslims, just one big family'
items.description: When a group of Jewish mates decided to support a newly arrived Muslim family, all of their lives would change. Together they have flipped expectations about religion and friendship.

items.title: Love story: Moana Hope has re-learnt what love means
items.description: The former AFLW player was an adult when she realised her childhood had warped her understanding of love.

items.title: How WWI helped shape what you call this deli meat
items.description: The words we use for a handful of classic Australian foods can tell a lot about where we come from.

items.title: From Heath Ledger protégé to abuse survivor, Grace Woodroofe perseveres
items.description: Heath Ledger launched her music career at just 17, but an emotionally abusive relationship with a fellow musician derailed it. A decade on, Grace Woodroofe is releasing the soundtrack to her survival.

items.title: Theoretical 'mirror life' could grow out of control, scientists fear
items.description: This year, scientists included a new potential threat in their decision to move the Doomsday Clock closer to midnight. So what is 'mirror life' and why are they concerned?

items.title: Man dies in hospital after stabbing at Newcastle unit block
items.description: An extensive forensic examination is underway at a unit block in Hamilton South after a man was fatally stabbed.

items.title: Time to bite the bullet? Unpopular decision looms over $600m Aboriginal gallery
items.description: Adelaide's stalled Aboriginal cultural centre has a dubious future on a site with a troubled past. The Malinauskas government faces criticism whatever it chooses to do, writes state political reporter Thomas Kelsall.

items.title: Premier Roger Cook takes over defence industries in cabinet reshuffle
items.description: WA Premier Roger Cook will take on the defence industries and tourism portfolios in a cabinet reshuffle, following the departure of longstanding minister Paul Papalia.

items.title: Teenage boy charged with murder of Victorian girl Layla Jeffery
items.description: The town of Donald in Victoria's west is in mourning, after remains believed to be missing 13-year-old Layla Jeffery were found by police on Thursday.

items.title: The easiest city for housing approvals — and the most restrictive
items.description: Four years on from a national pledge to unlock more housing, only one capital city allows townhouses or three-storey developments on most of its residential land.

items.title: Young country footballer 'alert' after serious on-field head knock
items.description: A young regional footballer who sustained a head knock and concussion during a match on Saturday is recovering well in a Melbourne hospital, according to his club.

items.title: Typhoon makes landfall in China as millions of people take shelter
items.description: Typhoon Bavi brings strong winds and heavy rain as it makes landfall in Zhejiang province in eastern China.
